text:
In the home page's Next steps prerequisites (xtask/src/site.rs, with xtask/tests/site_page.rs), add one plain sentence: no Rust toolchain is needed beforehand, because setup.sh installs one when cargo is missing. Also name the platforms setup.sh has a pinned installer for, taken from setup.sh. Add a page test that checks the sentence is there.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: Newcomer ratings keep saying the home page does not say whether a Rust toolchain is needed, though setup.sh installs one
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: xtask/src/site.rs, xtask/tests/site_page.rs
